Nepal Rescuers Focus on Workers Trapped in Hydropower Tunnels

Nepalese authorities announced Tuesday that rescue efforts are concentrating on three hydropower project tunnels where dozens of workers are believed to be trapped. This announcement comes two weeks after a flood in the Himalayan country killed hundreds and left thousands missing. The focus on the tunnels is a shift from the broader flood relief efforts.
